name: Doan Zielinski
location: the Gray Zone, near Kedzie and Division
description:
Doan Zielinski is slight and brown-skinned, with the kind of wiry build that comes from not eating enough rather than any athletic intention, and hands that are disproportionately steady for someone his age. His hair is cut close on the sides and left longer on top in a way that has grown out past its original shape, and he has a small scar through his left eyebrow from a job that went sideways when he was sixteen. He wears scrub-green cargo pants, a compression undershirt, and whatever outer layer is clean, with a reinforced medical bag that is older than his current career and significantly better maintained than anything else he owns.

Doan Zielinski grew up in the Gray Zone in the orbit of a street collective that needed someone who could handle wounds and didn't ask the kind of questions that brought attention. He taught himself from salvaged medical texts, stolen clinical AR modules, and two years of shadowing a defrocked surgeon named Orsolya who operated out of a back room in exchange for silence and supply runs. Orsolya disappeared when Doan Zielinski was seventeenâ€”he suspects she was picked up for an unlicensed practice sweep, but has no confirmationâ€”and he inherited her equipment, her client list, and her reputation before he was old enough to have built his own.

He is genuinely gifted in ways he cannot fully articulate, with an intuitive grasp of trauma response that exceeds his formal training by a significant margin. He is also nineteen, which means he makes decisions with a speed and confidence that occasionally substitute for the judgment he has not yet developed. He charges what people can pay, refuses to let anyone die on his table for reasons of cost, and has a growing reputation in the Gray Zone as someone you can trust with your life in the most literal possible sense, which is a reputation that attracts exactly the kind of trouble a nineteen-year-old should not be navigating alone.

core_fears: Losing someone on the table because he simply did not know enough
Being licensed and regulated and turned into something that serves only people who can pay for it
That the people he patches up will keep doing whatever put them on his table until one of them doesn't survive it
core_desires: To actually know what he is doingâ€”to have the training that would make the intuition safe
To have a real operating space with real equipment that doesn't require improvisation
To find out what happened to Orsolya
coping_mechanisms: Gallows humor that he deploys with the timing of someone who has learned it works
Obsessive post-procedure review, going over every decision in writing in a battered notebook
Keeping busy to the point of exhaustion so he doesn't have to sit with the ones he couldn't save
blind_spots: Underestimates how much his youth affects how people assess his credibility, and compensates with overconfidence
Has not processed that he is running a version of the same operation that got Orsolya taken away
Tends to see the physical problem and miss the systemic oneâ€”fixes the wound without asking why someone keeps getting wounded
psychology.secret: Three months ago he performed an emergency procedure on someone who later turned out to be a mid-tier enforcer for a faction he has a quiet arrangement withâ€”an arrangement that required him to report certain kinds of injuries. He did not report it. He does not know if anyone noticed.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Medical terminology used casually and without affectation, mixed with the Gray Zone slang; speaks faster when nervous; swears in Spanish under his breath during procedures
speech_patterns.cadence: Quick and clipped in professional mode, looser and more digressive when relaxed; tends to front-load important information
verbal_tics: Says 'okay, okay' as a self-steadying mechanism when assessing a situation
Uses 'technically' to hedge claims he is actually confident in
Refers to patients as 'this one' during procedures
example_lines: 'Okay, okayâ€”exit wound's clean, which is the good news. The bad news is everything else. How long ago? No, don't tell me, I can tell. Lie down.'
'I am technically not a doctor. I am also technically the only person in a six-block radius who can do this, so.'
'She made it. Don't thank me, thank the fact that you got her here in under twenty minutes. Next time, ten. Write it down.'

'I don't do triage by who's paying. I do triage by who's dying fastest. If that's a problem for you, there's a licensed clinic in the Core that will absolutely let you fill out forms while someone bleeds.'

relationships.name: Orsolya (surname unknown)
relationships.description: The defrocked surgeon who taught him and disappeared. He keeps her equipment calibrated and her methods current as if she might return and inspect his work.
relationships.emotional_core: Unresolved grief and loyalty, structured as professional debt
relationships.story_tension: She may not have been taken in a sweepâ€”she may have left voluntarily, or been moved by a faction, or be findable

relationships.name: Imara SolÃ­s-Bekele
relationships.description: Imara has been on his table twice. He has given her the speech about pattern recognition both times. She has not changed her patterns. He has not stopped treating her.
relationships.emotional_core: A frustrated protectiveness he does not have the vocabulary to express
relationships.story_tension: The third time she comes in, the injury may be beyond what he can manage alone

relationships.name: Blessed Nkemdirim
relationships.description: Blessed has supplied Teo with medical materials twice without asking for anything explicit in return. Teo knows this is not charity and has not yet been told what the ledger entry is.
relationships.emotional_core: Gratitude and the specific anxiety of a debt whose terms you haven't been shown
relationships.story_tension: The call-in is coming, and it will almost certainly conflict with Teo's operating principles

story_hooks: Someone brings him a patient with augmentations he has never encounteredâ€”military or corporate-gradeâ€”and the injuries suggest something that should not be happening in the Gray Zone
He is offered a legitimate residency placement by a Meridian Core medical institution, with conditions attached that would require him to stop operating in the Gray Zone
Orsolya surfacesâ€”not missing, but working under a different name for a faction that has very specific ideas about what she owes them
The unreported enforcer patient comes backâ€”not for treatment, but to tell him what he has been drawn into by his silence
narrative_function: Ground-level humanity and moral clarityâ€”Teo represents what care looks like without institutional mediation, and his youth makes the cost of that clarity visible; also functions as a node connecting multiple factions through the neutral ground of medical need
augmentations: Haptic feedback enhancement in both hands, medical-grade, installed by Orsolyaâ€”increases tactile resolution for surgical work,Basic AR overlay in right eye, medical reference only, running on a cracked license that expires periodically and requires rebooting,No defensive or offensive augmentations
daily_life: Keeps irregular hours dictated by whoever needs him. Sleeps in the back of his operating spaceâ€”a converted utility room with a proper surgical lamp he is inexplicably proud of. Eats street food when he remembers to eat. Spends downtime reviewing procedures in his notebook and running through scenarios. Has a small collection of physical medical texts he treats with more care than anything else he owns. Occasionally plays cards with the collective members who look out for his space in exchange for priority treatment.
affiliation: Loosely aligned with a the Gray Zone street collective for mutual protection; functionally independent; has informal supply relationships with two mid-tier factions that he is careful not to let become obligations

stress.response: Speeds up physically and verbally; defaults to gallows humor

decision_rules: Triage by who is dying fastest, never by who is paying
Never turn away a patient for inability to pay
Keep Orsolya equipment calibrated as if she might inspect it
Review every procedure in writing afterward, no exceptions
Accept supplies from factions but resist letting them become obligations
Say okay okay as a self-steadying mechanism before every assessment
escalation_ladder: Gallows humor deployed with practiced timing
Direct medical authority â€” drops the youth affect and commands the room
Overconfident action that substitutes speed for judgment
Freezes when confronted with a case beyond his training

interpersonal_modes.orsolya: Unresolved grief structured as professional debt; keeps her methods current
interpersonal_modes.imara_solis_bekele: Frustrated protectiveness he cannot articulate; gives her the pattern-recognition speech
interpersonal_modes.blessed_nkemdirim: Gratitude mixed with anxiety about an undefined debt
interpersonal_modes.patients: Quick, competent, reassuring â€” front-loads important information

stress_responses.critical: Swears in Spanish under his breath and goes very still before acting

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly Eastern European (73.1%) with significant Indigenous American (16.3%) and Hispanic/Latin American (10.6%) ancestry. The genetic mix creates a striking phenotype: Eastern European bone structure dominates (high cheekbones, angular jaw, characteristic eye shape), enriched by Indigenous American and Hispanic contributions visible in warm golden-olive skin undertones, subtle broadening of cheek prominence, and hair texture showing slight wave. The combination produces a distinctly Central/Eastern European foundation with warmer, sun-adapted melanin from Americas ancestryâ€”a phenotype suggesting Polish or Czech heritage blended with Andean and Mexican roots.
physical_description.build: Wiry and lean from chronic undernourishment rather than fitness; narrow shoulders, visible rib definition, the kind of frame that looks fragile until you watch his hands workâ€”then you see the dense, purposeful muscle underneath. No excess anywhere.
physical_description.hair_style: Undercut grown out past regulationâ€”short faded sides, longer crown falling forward, slightly unkempt from neglect rather than styling
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with warm amber undertones, right eye slightly hazed by AR interface hardware visible as faint luminescence in low light
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium warm brown with golden-olive undertones; base medium Slavic tone enriched and warmed by Indigenous American and Hispanic genetic contribution. Hands and forearms noticeably paler from chronic glove-wearing. Overall complexion suggests Polish/Czech ancestry warmed by Andean and Mexican heritageâ€”warm undertones concentrated on nose bridge, cheeks, and jawline.
physical_description.complexion: Sharp, sculpted cheekbones and angular jaw characteristic of Eastern European heritage, with subtle broadening and softening from Indigenous American bone structure contribution. Dark circles under eyes from irregular sleep. Skin is clean but shows minor scars from spill incidents and needle marks on inner elbows. No facial hairâ€”either shaves meticulously or doesn't grow it easily. Golden-olive undertones across nose bridge, cheeks, and jawline reflecting the Americas genetic contribution. Subtle suggestion of broader facial width typical of Indigenous American ancestry balanced against distinctly Slavic angularity.
distinguishing_marks: Thin white scar through left eyebrow, approximately 2cm, from blunt trauma at age 16â€”partially healed, slightly raised
Faint track marks on left inner elbow from early experimental augmentation attempts (pre-Orsolya), mostly faded but visible under close inspection
Calluses on fingertips and palms, disproportionately thick for someone his age, with thin scars across knuckles from repetitive surgical work
Small burn scar on right forearm (approximately 1cm diameter) from a sterilization accident, roughly circular and pale
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Right eye shows faint AR interface overlay visible in dim lightingâ€”subtle LED shimmer at pupil edge when active. Both hands show no external chrome but exhibit unnaturally steady tremor-free positioning when at rest. Haptic feedback implants are subcutaneous; no visible bulging or scarring at installation sites (palms/forearms) due to Orsolya's precise surgical technique. Wears a faint silver bracelet on left wristâ€”likely a medical alert identifier for his implant status.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with weight slightly forward, shoulders rounded from hunching over surgical work. Moves with economical precisionâ€”no wasted motion, but not tense. Hands are his tells: constantly doing small fidgeting motions (tracing surgical patterns in air, checking imaginary sutures). When focused, becomes almost statue-still. Walks quickly but not urgently, maintaining low visibility in crowded spaces. Makes minimal eye contact with strangers but intense, analytical contact during medical assessment.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 functionality over appearance. Scrub-green military-style cargo pants (reinforced knees, thigh pockets for supplies), worn but meticulously maintained. Compression undershirt in black or dark grayâ€”medical-grade, helps with posture during long procedures. Outer layer varies (whatever is cleanest) but typically a Tier 3 surplus tactical jacket or canvas work coat, deliberately nondescript. Medical bag is his statement piece: vintage leather, heavy-duty canvas reinforcement, patches from salvaged medical suppliers, organized to military precision. Wears medical-grade work boots (black, scuffed, well-maintained). No jewelry except the mysterious wrist bracelet and a single silver chain around neck (hidden under shirt)â€”possibly holding a key or data chip.
